prerequisites: Ideally, you should have taken part in the communication CEs in previous semesters.

learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to write a CV and cover letter adapted to the search for an EFP and a future first job.
They will be able to adapt a rapid personal presentation to the recruiter's expectations.
They will have carried out an in-depth reflection on their future career path, which will be presented orally.
Know how to identify the main networks, be aware of their interest in finding an internship and understand how to activate them.
Understand the purpose of a resume and how to express your motivation to a recruiter.
Know how to write these documents attractively and completely.
Understand a recruiter's expectations and know how to convince them of the interest of your application through communication.
Give a rapid oral presentation of your assets at the start of an interview.
Research information and work on yourself to build your career path after leaving school.
Be aware of the importance of oral presentations in convincing an audience.

syllabus_topics: Presentation of the particularities of a CV and cover letter for a student at the end of an engineering course.
Presentation of the importance of networking for professional insertion.
Reminder of the elements of oral communication and training for a succinct personal presentation to a recruiter within a given timeframe, with suggestions for improvement.
Individualized work on each student's CV and letters.
Construction of a career path project.
Training in speaking about the desired career path, with personalized comments.
Learning to speak in public through training exercises, with commentary and evolution.
Work on verbal and non-verbal aspects.
Collective analysis of work in session.
General information on finding an internship through help with optimizing CVs and cover letters and/or covering letters.
Individualized approach based on each student's personal data and expectations.
Constructive participation in the Career Forum and Career Day.
